description: Every constructor gate has at most three clauses and seven literal occurrences, and every gate clause has length at most three.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.gate_bounds.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.gate A).length ≤ 3 ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.literalCount (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.gate A) ≤
        7 ∧
      ∀ C ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.gate A, C.length ≤ 3
